test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word segment that can substitute the bracketed word segment correctly and complete the sentence meaningfully.

(Everyone carefully were trying to) reason with the CEO regarding the need for worklife balance during the upcoming festivals.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence contains a grammatical error with the verb tense agreement. "**Everyone carefully were trying to**" is incorrect because "everyone" is a singular subject and requires a singular verb form.
 
• Option 1 correctly uses "**was**" which agrees with the singular subject "**everyone**".
 
• Other options either use incorrect verb forms or are grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Everyone was carefully trying to reason with the CEO regarding the need for work-life balance during the upcoming festivals."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Everyone had carefully trying to"** is incorrect because "had" should be followed by "been" to form the correct past perfect continuous tense ("had been trying").
 
• **Option 3: "Everyone did carefully tried to"** is incorrect because "did" should be followed by the base form of the verb ("try").
 
• **Option 4: "Everyone were carefully trying to"** is incorrect because "were" does not agree with the singular subject "everyone".
